basic_info.description: Nestled in a friendly, tree-lined neighborhood, this beautiful 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. As you enter, you're welcomed into a generous living space with period brick fireplace, ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. The adjoining dining room provides an elegant space for family meals or dinner parties.  The heart of the home is the kitchen, a true chef's dream! Featuring gleaming quartz countertops, modern appliances, and a charming breakfast nook, it opens seamlessly to a spacious deck perfect for outdoor dining or weekend gatherings. Enjoy the tranquility of the large, gracious garden, complete with a lush turf area surrounded by a picturesque stone. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, including a peaceful master retreat, and a well-appointed full bath. The lower level offers two more bedrooms, another full bath, a large laundry room, and a generous two-car garage for convenience and extra storage.  Whether you're hosting in the backyard, cooking in the kitchen, or enjoying the charm of the neighborhood, this home truly offers a wonderful lifestyle. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make it yours!
